content_sections.heading: NFC ITI Apprentice Vacancy 2026 - Trade-Wise Details
content_sections.text: NFC has advertised 432 tentative vacancies for ITI Trade Apprentices across 16 trades. The trade-wise breakup along with the applicable stipend is given below. The above vacancies may increase or decrease based on office exigencies, as stated in the notification.

content_sections.heading: NFC ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed 10th standard and ITI in the respective/related trade to be eligible for the corresponding NFC apprentice post. The following conditions also apply: Candidates with post-graduation are not eligible to apply Candidates who have already undergone, or are currently undergoing, Apprenticeship under the Apprentices Act, 1961, in any Government, PSU, or Private Organisation are not eligible to apply Candidates for Technician (ITI) Apprentice must have registered their names on the NAPS portal (apprenticeshipindia.gov.in) and can apply only through the portal

content_sections.heading: NFC ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Stipend
content_sections.text: Selected candidates are entitled to a monthly stipend as per the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961, based on their trade.

rows.trades: Fitter, Turner, Electrician, Machinist, Attendant Operator (Chemical Plant), Instrument Mechanic, Electronics Mechanic, Laboratory Assistant (Chemical Plant), Motor Mechanics (Vehicle), Draughtsman (Mechanical)
COPA, Diesel Mechanic, Carpenter, Plumber, Welder, Stenographer (English)

content_sections.heading: NFC ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: No application fee is specified in the notification for applying through the NAPS portal.

content_sections.heading: NFC ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age of the apprentice should not be less than 18 years as on the closing date of application. The upper age limit is as follows: To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: NFC ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is done through Walk-in-Interview; there is no written examination. The Selection Committees of NFC review the applications received through the NAPS portal and select candidates, as per the vacancies indicated, through Walk-in-Interview The outcome of the selection is communicated to selected candidates through e-mail Reservation is applied as per the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961 and Apprentice Rules 1992, as amended from time to time Candidates claiming reservation under SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) must mention this at the time of registration on the NAPS portal, failing which they will be considered under the General category, and must bring the original certificate at the time of joining Suppression of facts by applicants can lead to disqualification at any stage of the selection process, and any deviation found during credential verification will result in summary rejection of candidature Every apprentice who completes the training period must undergo a Trade Test to determine proficiency in the designated trade; only on passing the Trade Test is the National Apprenticeship Certificate awarded by the Controller of Examination (DGT) through the Apprenticeship portal

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NFC ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must apply online only through the NAPS portal, using the Establishment Name/Code Nuclear Fuel Complex-E11153600013. Register as a Candidate on the NAPS portal: www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in After successful registration, log in to the NAPS portal using the registered e-mail ID (username) and password Click on "Apprenticeship Opportunities" and type "Nuclear Fuel Complex-E11153600013" against "Search by Establishment Name" From the list of trades operated at NFC, Hyderabad, click "Apply" against the desired trade Upload all required documents/certificates on the portal as prescribed Submit the application on or before the last date, 16 September 2026

content_sections.heading: NFC ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The offer of Apprenticeship does not confer any right of employment in NFC, and there is no provision for appointment of the Apprenticeship Trainee in NFC after completion of training Selected candidates shall be required to report at NFC, Hyderabad, and must execute a contract for one year of training as per the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961 No TA/DA shall be admissible for joining, if selected Selected candidates must submit a Medical Fitness Certificate from an Assistant Civil Surgeon/Civil Surgeon at the time of joining Apprentices are provided accommodation by the establishment, subject to availability of quarters Candidates should immediately start the process of obtaining a Police Verification certificate of the address on their Aadhaar card, as it will be required on the date of reporting for joining The following documents must be produced in original at the time of physical verification, along with photocopies: 10th/SSC marksheet/certificate; ITI marksheet and National Trade Certificate; Caste Certificate and Disability Certificate (if applicable); Medical/Health Insurance from a reputed institution; Aadhaar card; Police Verification Certificate; Savings Bank A/C number and passbook; hard copy of the online application form; and 2 recent passport-size photographs Where the apprenticeship contract is terminated due to failure on the part of the apprentice to fulfil its terms, the apprentice must refund the training cost to NFC as determined by the Apprenticeship Adviser, and will not be entitled to enter into another apprenticeship contract under the Apprentices Act, 1961, with any other organisation Any canvassing or personal follow-up intended to influence the selection process shall lead to immediate cancellation of candidature In case of any dispute, the decision of the NFC Management shall be final

faq.question: Q1. What is NFC ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an engagement of ITI Trade Apprentices by Nuclear Fuel Complex, Hyderabad, under the Apprentices Act, 1961, for one year of training in 16 trades, for the year 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under NFC ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 432 tentative vacancies are available across 16 trades, including Fitter, Turner, Electrician, Machinist, COPA, Welder, and others.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NFC ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of applications is 16 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for NFC ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 10th standard and ITI in the respective/related trade. Candidates with post-graduation are not eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NFC ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years as on the closing date of application. The upper age limit is 25 years for General, 28 years for OBC, and 30 years for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the NFC Apprentice training be conducted?
faq.answer: The apprenticeship training will be conducted at Nuclear Fuel Complex, Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for NFC ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must register and apply online through the NAPS portal (apprenticeshipindia.gov.in), searching for Establishment Name/Code "Nuclear Fuel Complex-E11153600013" and clicking Apply against the desired trade.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for NFC ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through Walk-in-Interview. NFC's Selection Committees review applications and select candidates as per the vacancies indicated, with results communicated by e-mail.

faq.question: Q9. What is the stipend for NFC ITI Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: The stipend is ₹11,040/- per month for trades such as Fitter, Turner, Electrician, Machinist and others, and ₹10,560/- per month for COPA, Diesel Mechanic, Carpenter, Plumber, Welder, and Stenographer (English).

faq.question: Q10. Does NFC ITI Apprenticeship guarantee a job after training?
faq.answer: No. The offer of Apprenticeship does not confer any right of employment in NFC, and there is no provision for appointment after completion of training.
